sign.text: FIRE KEEPER. Too little fire: one dark wood. Too much: bare grass. Set the dial.

dialogue.line: Oaks shade out everything. The meadow herbs we brew with are going.
From up here you see it: patches of every age is a healthy island.
One burn per patch every 25 to 50 years. Turn the dial and watch the mosaic.
Firebreaks keep the burn to its patch. Never near the hives or the pens.

feedback.0.0: Only oak. Silence under the canopy.
feedback.0.03: Meadow, scrub, pine and oak side by side.
feedback.0.32: Grass and ash, nothing older than a year.

fail_hint: If H is low, ask: is everything the same age?
